name: EVA Berlin Conference 2026: Intelligence Space – Creativity in Dialogue with Technology
description: The 29th EVA Berlin Conference addresses the convergence of digital technologies, AI, and cultural practice. Topics include generative AI in artistic production, digital heritage preservation, social prescribing through museums, and data poetics. This interdisciplinary gathering brings together researchers from museology, art history, computer science, and digital humanities to examine how museums are evolving into transdisciplinary hubs of social innovation.
